_readme: Single source of truth for the Work page. Edit here, then run: python3 scripts/build.py. Fields set to null are not yet confirmed by Paul and are left off the page. Catalogue = 'Mind Mechanics, Selected Works 2025-2026' (Galerie Bruno Massa); where a work is in the catalogue, its wording wins.

works.process_text: No. 58 is built in layers. It began as a red canvas. Parchment paper was laid onto the colour, and yellow paint was splattered over it. A second layer of parchment paper followed, painted black, and on this ground the profile was drawn in spray paint and oil stick. Only then did the excavation begin: digging back through the black until the red and yellow beneath surfaced again, as a fragment inside the head. No. 58 is the first work made this way.
